name: TaxAct
shortDescription: Online filing with guided steps. The homepage says you can start filing for free.
longDescription: TaxAct's homepage says people use it to file taxes online, with guided filing and expert help for more complex situations, and it says you can start filing for free. The page did not include a dollar price.
pricingNotes: The homepage says start filing for free and mentions guided filing plus expert help. No dollar amount was in the fetch.
bestFor: Starting a personal return online with guided questions
notIdealFor: Someone who needs a listed monthly subscription price
strength: TaxAct's homepage offers guided online filing and says you can start filing for free.
weakness: The homepage did not print a dollar price for paid expert help.
